books.note: Opens with the mātikā, 22 triads and 100 dyads, then analyses each kind of citta into its factors.
Eighteen chapters, most treated by the sutta method, the Abhidhamma method and by questions.
Shows how each dhamma is included in, or excluded from, the aggregates, bases and elements.
Types of people. The one book about conventional rather than ultimate reality.
Refutes the views of other early schools in debate form.
Pins down the scope of each term with paired, converse questions.
Applies 24 conditions to every dhamma. The largest book, called the Great Treatise.
